label: Manufacturing and light production
specifics: Cover concretely: Bills of materials, work orders, consuming raw stock into finished goods, wastage, job costing against a quoted price, and knowing the true unit cost before quoting the next order.

label: Logistics and transport
specifics: Cover concretely: Per-trip and per-tonne rates, waiting time and demurrage, fuel surcharges, disbursements paid on behalf of a client at customs, proof of delivery attached to the invoice, and monthly consolidated billing for contract clients.

label: Clinics and healthcare practices
specifics: Cover concretely: Per-consultation and per-procedure billing, packages sold up front and consumed over visits (which are unearned income until used), consumables stock, and separating practitioner revenue for payout.

label: Education and training centres
specifics: Cover concretely: Term and course fees billed in advance, instalment plans, sibling and early-bird discounts, per-student receipts, and unearned fee income recognised as the course is delivered.

label: Real estate and property management
specifics: Cover concretely: Rent invoiced on a schedule, security deposits held as a liability and never as income, service charges recharged to tenants, commission on a sale or a letting, and owner statements.

label: Automotive workshops and dealers
specifics: Cover concretely: Labour hours at a shop rate, parts with part numbers and margin, a diagnostic fee credited against the repair, the estimate-then-authorise sequence, and warranty work billed to a third party.

label: Online and e-commerce sellers
specifics: Cover concretely: Order volume, stock held across channels, cost of goods sold per order, returns and the credit note they need, shipping recharged or absorbed, and reconciling gateway payouts against orders.

label: Hotels, cafes and hospitality
specifics: Cover concretely: Covers versus revenue per head, recipe and portion costing, wastage, supplier deliveries against a purchase order, staff rota cost against revenue, and daily cash-up.

label: Professional services firms
specifics: Cover concretely: Time and materials versus fixed fee, work in progress that is earned but not yet billed, retainers held against future work, disbursements recovered at cost, and billing on a monthly cycle.

label: Wholesale and distribution
specifics: Cover concretely: Price lists and customer-specific pricing, credit terms and limits per customer, bulk and break-bulk units, landed cost on imports, stock ageing, and consolidated monthly statements.
